conventions.cells: (x, y), y down, world frame of REG1 (stations, module) or the unit template frame (bodies)
conventions.window: ofRows x0 y0 rows: bit j of rows[i] is the cell (x0 + j, y0 + i); rows above 2^53 are given as decimal strings
conventions.world_line: (dir, lane, tau) as scripts/life_gates/life.glider_at: dir in SE/SW/NW/NE, lane = dy*x - dx*y, the glider is the canonical phase at x = dx*q at time tau + 4 q; a glider (d, lane, tau + s) is the same glider s generations later
conventions.pieces: ('asm', k, x, y, s) = blockedStream (the OR gate piece), ('rf', k, x, y, s) = RF0, symmetry k, translated, delayed by s (scripts/life_machine/net.piece_cells)
conventions.G: the union of the pieces at time t0 (t0 = 0 mod 30, so every piece is at phase 0 of the common clock) and the eater cells; period 30 checked
conventions.B: bounding box of G over its 30-cycle (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax); Lean Box xmin xmax ymin ymax
conventions.R: hull of the bounding boxes of the exact evolution of G u In over [t0, t0 + Delta] and of B (R_tight: without B; B_in_R_tight says whether hull was needed)
conventions.equation: evolve Delta (G u In) = (pieces at t0 + Delta) u Out, i.e. phase G Delta u Out; In and Out at Chebyshev distance >= 3 from the whole envelope (all phases) of the pieces
